jobs.description:
At STRABAG, around 89,000 people at more than 2,400 locations worldwide are building progress. Uniqueness and individual strengths characterise not only our projects but also each and every one of us. Whether in building and civil engineering, road and underground construction, bridge and tunnel construction, building materials production, project development, or building management – we think construction forward to become the most innovative and sustainable construction technology group in Europe. Equal opportunities, diversity, and inclusion are integral parts of what defines us as a company and how we work.
 Together, we implement projects successfully and in partnership and grow through new challenges. Together, we create greatness. Let's progress!

Construction Machinery Mechanic: Specialist in Deep Foundation Engineering
 Your Contribution with Us

• Overhauls, repairs, as well as service and maintenance work on specialist deep foundation machinery in the workshop and on construction sites in Switzerland

• Repair of various small devices

• General mechanical and welding work
 What Counts for Us

• Completed training as a construction machinery, agricultural machinery, or truck / motor vehicle mechanic – recent graduates are warmly welcome!

• Driving licence category B

• Willingness to travel to construction sites throughout Switzerland

• Independent, precise, and reliable working style

• Willingness for professional development

• Team player, flexible and resilient

Our Added Value for You
 You will have the opportunity to develop both personally and professionally within the team. The framework conditions include, among other things, practical training opportunities as well as attractive discounts for employees. Do you enjoy construction machinery and equipment, work precisely, reliably and with quality awareness, and are you open to modern technology and exciting tasks in our machinery park? Then please send us your complete and meaningful application documents, including your earliest possible starting date and salary expectations, via the online form.

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire d'atelier de réparation de machines de construction

jobs.description:
At STRABAG, around 89,000 people at more than 2,400 locations worldwide are building progress. Uniqueness and individual strengths characterise not only our projects but also each and every one of us. Whether in building and civil engineering, road and underground construction, bridge and tunnel construction, in building materials production, project development or building management – we think construction forward to become the most innovative and sustainable construction technology group in Europe. Equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion are integral parts of what defines us as a company and how we work.
 Together we implement projects successfully and in partnership and grow with new tasks. Together we create great things. Let's progress!

Workshop Manager for Construction Machinery Repair
 Your Contribution with Us

• Responsibility for the smooth running and coordination of orders in the workshop (resources, capacity, machines, vehicles)

• Leadership, motivation and professional support of the existing workshop team, consisting of construction machinery mechanics and locksmiths

• Organisation and execution of equipment repairs in direct consultation with our operational users
Preparation of cost estimates, ordering of spare parts and subsequent invoicing of repair services

• Responsible for the training of our apprentices in the vocational professions of construction machinery mechanic EFZ and locksmith EFZ

• Support of the team during overhauls, repairs as well as service and maintenance work on our construction machinery and equipment during bottlenecks, both in the workshop and on site
 What Counts for Us

• Completed vocational training EFZ as construction machinery / agricultural machinery or truck mechanic

• Further training as workshop manager or diagnostic technician is an advantage

• Several years of professional experience in a workshop or technical service, ideally with leadership responsibility

• Administrative skills as well as sound handling of IT systems, such as MS Office and AS4U

• Driving licence category B is mandatory, additional driving licences (forklift etc.) are an advantage

• Team spirit, high service and customer orientation and pronounced cost awareness combined with an independent and precise way of working

• Willingness for professional development

Our Added Value for You
 In addition to a secure workplace, we offer you an exciting and varied range of tasks in an international group. Together with a qualified and collegial team, you will look after machines from various areas of the group and experience a flat hierarchy and exemplary leadership at eye level. You will also have the opportunity to develop both personally and professionally within the team. The framework conditions include, among other things, practice-oriented training opportunities as well as attractive discounts for employees. Do you enjoy construction machinery and equipment, work precisely, reliably and with quality awareness, and are open to modern technology and exciting tasks in our machine park? Then please send us your complete and meaningful application documents stating your earliest possible starting date and salary expectations via the online form.

At STRABAG, around 89,000 people at more than 2,400 locations worldwide are building progress. Uniqueness and individual strengths characterise not only our projects but also each and every one of us. Equal opportunities, diversity, and inclusion are integral parts of what defines us as a company and how we work.
 Together, we implement projects successfully and in partnership and grow with new tasks. Together, we create great things. Let's progress!

Construction Clerk 80 to 100%
 Your contribution with us

• You independently and purposefully handle the operational commercial tasks of your construction projects

• You are responsible for internal accounting and the monthly site billing (creditors and debtors)

• You help shape the operational goals, strategy, and planning of your projects

• You collect the economic key data of the construction sites and projects, including target-actual comparisons

• You are jointly responsible for project controlling together with site management

• You participate in acquisition and project start-up (AVOR)

• You take care of the personnel administration of the operational site staff

• You support the commercial trainees
 What counts for us

• You have a commercial basic education or a technical apprenticeship with further training in the commercial field

• You have already gained professional experience in a similar position, preferably in the construction industry

• You have a strong affinity for numbers and convince through commitment, reliability, and a quick grasp

• You are team-oriented and keep an overview even in hectic times

• An independent, proactive, and responsible working style rounds off your profile

• Your workload is 80 to 100%, the place of employment is Schlieren

• Start date from 2027

Our added value for you

• A responsible role with direct influence on the success of our projects

• A well-coordinated team that sticks together, with joint events and company functions

• Individual development and training opportunities

• Modern work equipment and the possibility for home office

• Fair employment conditions in an internationally active construction group

• Free drinks, parking, good transport connections, and employee discounts
